name: Saltspire
description: A hot white star over salt flats and a scarred rock with a bright moon. Evaporation pans the size of seas crust over every summer. The salt pays for everything, including the shade.

stars.name: Saltspire Glare
stars.description: A fast white star whose fierce light evaporates seas into salt in a single season. It spins fast enough to bulge at the equator. Parasols the size of towns shade the harvest.

planets.name: Saltflat
planets.description: A desert of evaporite pans stretching to every horizon, white as paper. Harvester crawlers scrape the crust on endless circuits. The salt here seasons food across three sectors.

moons.name: Brine
moons.description: A bright salt-crusted moon holding the system's water in buried lenses. Every drop is piped, priced, and prayed over. Its phases set the harvest festivals.

planets.name: Scarrock
planets.description: A pocked rock that takes the system's impacts so the salt pans don't have to. Fresh craters bloom every decade from belt debris. Impact insurance here costs more than hulls.
